Fix: never set color: in classDef, 92 and always include these CSS overrides. */ 93 .mermaid .nodeLabel { color: var(--text) !important; } 94 .mermaid .edgeLabel { color: var(--text-dim) !important; background-color: var(--bg) !important; } 95 .mermaid .edgeLabel rect { fill: var(--bg) !important; } 96 97 /* Node shapes */ 98 .mermaid .node rect, 99 .mermaid .node circle, 100 .mermaid .node polygon { 101 stroke-width: 1.5px; 102 } 103 104 /* Edge paths */ 105 .mermaid .edge-pattern-solid { 106 stroke-width: 1.5px; 107 } 108 109 /* Edge labels — smaller than node labels for visual hierarchy */ 110 .mermaid .edgeLabel { 111 font-family: var(--font-mono) !important; 112 font-size: 13px !important; 113 } 114 115 /* Node labels — 16px default; drop to 14px for complex diagrams (20+ nodes) */ 116 .mermaid .nodeLabel { 117 font-family: var(--font-body) !important; 118 font-size: 16px !important; 119 } 120 121 /* Sequence diagram actors */ 122 .mermaid .actor { 123 stroke-width: 1.5px; 124 } 125 126 /* Sequence diagram messages */ 127 .mermaid .messageText { 128 font-family: var(--font-mono) !important; 129 font-size: 12px !important; 130 } 131 132 /* ER diagram entities */ 133 .mermaid .er.entityBox { 134 stroke-width: 1.5px; 135 } 136 137 /* Mind map nodes */ 138 .mermaid .mindmap-node rect { 139 stroke-width: 1.5px; 140 } 141 ``` 142 143 ### classDef and style Gotchas 144 145 `classDef` values and per-node `style` directives are static text inside `
` — they can't use CSS variables or JS ternaries. Two rules:
146	
147	1. **Never set `color:` in classDef or per-node `style` directives.** It hardcodes a text color that breaks in the opposite color scheme. This applies to both `classDef highlight fill:...,color:#2c2a25` and `style I fill:...,color:#2c2a25`. Let the CSS overrides above handle text color via `var(--text)`.
148	
149	2. **Use semi-transparent fills (8-digit hex) for node backgrounds.** They layer over whatever Mermaid's base theme background is, producing a tint that works in both light and dark modes. Use `20`–`44` alpha for subtle, `55`–`77` for prominent:
150	
151	```
152	classDef highlight fill:#b5761433,stroke:#b57614,stroke-width:2px
153	classDef muted fill:#7c6f6411,stroke:#7c6f6444,stroke-width:1px
154	```
155	
156	### Node Label Special Characters
157	
158	Mermaid uses certain characters for shape syntax. Node labels containing these characters cause syntax errors unless quoted.
159	
160	**Shape characters to watch:**
161	- `[/text/]` — parallelogram
162	- `[\text\]` — trapezoid (alt)
163	- `[/text\]` — trapezoid
164	- `[\text/]` — trapezoid (alt)
165	- `[(text)]` — cylindrical
166	- `[[text]]` — subroutine
167	- `((text))` — circle
168	- `{{text}}` — hexagon
169	
170	**If your node label starts with `/`, `\`, `(`, or `{`, wrap it in quotes:**
171	
172	```
173	%% WRONG — syntax error (/ starts parallelogram shape)
174	CMD[/gallery command] --> SRV[server]
175	
176	%% RIGHT — quotes escape the special character
177	CMD["/gallery command"] --> SRV[server]
178	```
179	
180	**Edge labels with special characters also need quotes:**
181	
182	```
183	%% WRONG — quotes inside edge label
184	UI -->|"Use as Reference"| RET
185	
186	%% RIGHT — use single quotes or escape
187	UI -->|'Use as Reference'| RET
188	UI -->|Use as Reference| RET
189	```
190	
191	Avoid opaque light fills like `fill:#fefce8` — they render as bright boxes in dark mode.
192	
193	### stateDiagram-v2 Label Limitations
194	
195	State diagram transition labels have a strict parser. Avoid:
196	- `
` — only works in flowcharts; causes a parse error in state diagrams
197	- Parentheses in labels — `cancel()` can confuse the parser
198	- Multiple colons — the first `:` is the label delimiter; extra colons in the label text may break parsing
199	
200	If you need multi-line labels or special characters, use a `flowchart` instead of `stateDiagram-v2`. Flowcharts support quoted labels (`|"label with: special chars"|`) and `
` for line breaks.
201	
202	### Writing Valid Mermaid
203	
204	Most Mermaid failures come from a few recurring issues. Follow these rules to avoid invalid diagrams:
205	
206	**For multi-line flowchart node labels, use `
` (not `\n`).** Mermaid flowcharts interpret `
` as a line break, but escaped `\n` in labels often renders as literal text:
207	
208	```
209	%% WRONG — renders literal "\n" in node text
210	A["Copilot Backend\n/api + /api/voicebot"] --> B["Redis"]
211	
212	%% RIGHT — renders on two lines
213	A["Copilot Backend
/api + /api/voicebot"] --> B["Redis"]
214	```
215	
216	**Quote labels with special characters.** Parentheses, colons, commas, brackets, and ampersands break the parser when unquoted. Wrap any label containing special characters in double quotes:
217	
218	```
219	A["handleRequest(ctx)"] --> B["DB: query users"]
220	A[handleRequest] --> B[query users]
221	```
222	
223	**Keep IDs simple.** Node IDs should be alphanumeric with no spaces or punctuation. Put the readable name in the label, not the ID:
224	
225	```
226	userSvc["User Service"] --> authSvc["Auth Service"]
227	```
228	
229	**Max 10-12 nodes per Mermaid diagram.** Beyond that, readability collapses even with zoom controls and increased fontSize. For complex architectures (15+ elements), use the **hybrid pattern**: a simple 5-8 node Mermaid overview showing module relationships, followed by CSS Grid cards with detailed function lists. Never cram everything into one diagram. Use `subgraph` blocks to group related nodes when under the limit:
230	
231	```
232	subgraph Auth
233	  login --> validate --> token
234	end
235	subgraph API
236	  gateway --> router --> handler
237	end
238	Auth --> API
239	```
240	
241	**Arrow styles for semantic meaning:**
242	
243	| Arrow | Meaning | Use for |
244	|-------|---------|---------|
245	| `-->` | Solid | Primary flow |
246	| `-.->` | Dotted | Optional, async, or fallback paths |
247	| `==>` | Thick | Critical or highlighted path |
248	| `--x` | Cross | Rejected or blocked |
249	| `-->\|label\|` | Labeled | Decision branches, data descriptions |
250	
251	**Escape pipes in labels.** If a label contains a literal `|`, use `#124;` (HTML entity) or rephrase to avoid it — pipes delimit edge labels in flowcharts.
252	
253	**Sequence diagram messages must be plain text.** Unlike flowchart labels, sequence diagram messages (the text after `:`) cannot be quoted or escaped. Curly braces `{}`, square brackets `[]`, angle brackets `<>`, and `&` will silently break the parser and the entire diagram renders as raw text. Write human-readable descriptions, not code:
254	
255	```
256	%% WRONG — parser chokes on braces, brackets, ampersand
257	A->>B: web_search({ queries: [...] })
258	B->>B: User removes query 2, keeps 1 & 3
259	B->>S: POST /submit { selected: [0, 2] }
260	
261	%% RIGHT — plain English, no special characters
262	A->>B: Call web_search with queries
263	B->>B: User removes query 2, keeps 1 and 3
264	B->>S: POST /submit with selected indices
265	```
266	
267	**Don't mix diagram syntax.** Each diagram type has its own syntax. `-->` works in flowcharts but not in sequence diagrams (`->>` instead). `:::className` works in flowcharts but not in ER diagrams. When in doubt, check the examples below for correct syntax per type.
268	
269	### Layout Direction: TD vs LR
270	
271	`flowchart LR` (left-to-right) spreads horizontally. With many nodes, Mermaid scales everything down to fit the width, making text unreadable. `flowchart TD` (top-down) is almost always better.
272	
273	**When to use each:**
274	
275	| Direction | Use when | Avoid when |
276	|-----------|----------|------------|
277	| `TD` (top-down) | Complex diagrams, 5+ nodes, hierarchies, architecture | Simple A→B→C linear flows |
278	| `LR` (left-to-right) | Simple linear flows, 3-4 nodes, pipelines | Complex graphs, many branches |
279	
280	**Rule of thumb:** If the diagram has more than one row of nodes or any branching, use `TD`. The extra vertical space makes labels readable.
281	
282	```
283	%% WRONG — LR with many nodes produces wide, short, unreadable diagram
284	flowchart LR
285	  A --> B --> C --> D --> E
286	  A --> F --> G --> H
287	  
288	%% RIGHT — TD uses vertical space, labels stay readable
289	flowchart TD
290	  A --> B --> C --> D --> E
291	  A --> F --> G --> H
292	```
293	
294	### Diagram Type Examples
295	
296	**Flowchart with decisions:**
297	```html
298	
299	graph TD
300	  A[Request] --> B{Authenticated?}
301	  B -->|Yes| C[Load Dashboard]
302	  B -->|No| D[Login Page]
303	  D --> E[Submit Credentials]
304	  E --> B
305	  C --> F{Role?}
306	  F -->|Admin| G[Admin Panel]
307	  F -->|User| H[User Dashboard]
308	

309	```
310	
311	**Sequence diagram:**
312	```html
313	
314	sequenceDiagram
315	  participant C as Client
316	  participant G as Gateway
317	  participant S as Service
318	  participant D as Database
319	  C->>G: POST /api/data
320	  G->>G: Validate JWT
321	  G->>S: Forward request
322	  S->>D: Query
323	  D-->>S: Results
324	  S-->>G: Response
325	  G-->>C: 200 OK
326	

327	```
328	
329	**ER diagram:**
330	```html
331	
332	erDiagram
333	  USERS ||--o{ ORDERS : places
334	  ORDERS ||--|{ LINE_ITEMS : contains
335	  LINE_ITEMS }o--|| PRODUCTS : references
336	  USERS { string email PK }
337	  ORDERS { int id PK }
338	  LINE_ITEMS { int quantity }
339	  PRODUCTS { string name }
340	

341	```
342	
343	**State diagram:**
344	```html
345	
346	stateDiagram-v2
347	  [*] --> Draft
348	  Draft --> Review : submit
349	  Review --> Approved : approve
350	  Review --> Draft : request_changes
351	  Approved --> Published : publish
352	  Published --> Archived : archive
353	  Archived --> [*]
354	

355	```
356	
357	**Mind map:**
358	```html
359	
360	mindmap
361	  root((Project))
362	    Frontend
363	      React
364	      Next.js
365	      Tailwind
366	    Backend
367	      Node.js
368	      PostgreSQL
369	      Redis
370	    Infrastructure
371	      AWS
372	      Docker
373	      Terraform
374	

375	```
376	
377	**Class diagram:**
378	```html
379	
380	classDiagram
381	  class User {
382	    +string email
383	    +string name
384	    +login()
385	    +logout()
386	  }
387	  class Order {
388	    +int id
389	    +decimal total
390	    +submit()
391	  }
392	  class Product {
393	    +string name
394	    +decimal price
395	  }
396	  User "1" --> "*" Order : places
397	  Order "*" --> "*" Product : contains
398	

399	```
400	
401	**C4 architecture (flowchart-as-C4):**
402	```html
403	
404	graph TD
405	  user("👤 User
Browser client")
406	  subgraph boundary["Web Platform"]
407	    app["Web App
Node.js"]
408	    db[("Database
PostgreSQL")]
409	  end
410	  email["📧 Email Service"]:::ext
411	  payment["💳 Payment Gateway"]:::ext
412	  user -->|"HTTPS"| app
413	  app -->|"SQL"| db
414	  app -->|"SMTP"| email
415	  app -->|"API"| payment
416	  classDef ext fill:none,stroke-dasharray:5 5
417	

418	```
419	
420	Do NOT use native `C4Context` / `C4Container` syntax — it hardcodes sharp corners, its own font, and inline colors that ignore `themeVariables`. Use `graph TD` + `subgraph` for C4 boundaries instead; it inherits all theme settings automatically.
421	
422	### Which Mermaid Diagram Type?
423	
424	Quick-reference for choosing the right Mermaid syntax:
425	
426	| You want to show... | Use | Syntax keyword |
427	|---|---|---|
428	| Process flow, decisions, pipelines | Flowchart | `graph TD` / `graph LR` |
429	| Request/response, API calls, temporal interactions | Sequence diagram | `sequenceDiagram` |
430	| Database tables and relationships | ER diagram | `erDiagram` |
431	| OOP classes, domain models with methods | Class diagram | `classDiagram` |
432	| System architecture at multiple zoom levels | C4 diagram | `graph TD` + `subgraph` (not native `C4Context`) |
433	| State transitions, lifecycles | State diagram | `stateDiagram-v2` |
434	| Hierarchical breakdowns, brainstorms | Mind map | `mindmap` |
435	
436	### Dark Mode Handling
437	
438	Mermaid initializes once — it can't reactively switch themes. Read the preference at load time inside your `
453	
454	
455	
456	
488	```
489	
490	Wrap the canvas in a styled container:
491	```css
492	.chart-container {
493	  background: var(--surface);
494	  border: 1px solid var(--border);
495	  border-radius: 10px;
496	  padding: 20px;
497	  position: relative;
498	}
499	
500	.chart-container canvas {
501	  max-height: 300px;
502	}
503	```
504	
505	## anime.js — Orchestrated Animations
506	
507	Use when a diagram has 10+ elements and you want a choreographed entrance sequence (staggered reveals, path drawing, count-up numbers). For simpler diagrams, CSS `animation-delay` staggering is sufficient.
508	
509	```html
510	
511	
512	
546	```
547	
548	When using anime.js, set initial opacity to 0 in CSS so elements don't flash before the animation:
549	```css
550	.ve-card { opacity: 0; }
551	
552	@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
553	  .ve-card { opacity: 1 !important; }
554	}
555	```
556	
557	## Google Fonts — Typography
558	
559	Always load with `display=swap` for fast rendering. Pick a distinctive pairing — body + mono at minimum, optionally a display font for the title.
560	
561	**FORBIDDEN as `--font-body` (AI slop signals):**
562	- Inter — the single most overused AI default font
563	- Roboto — generic Android/Google default
564	- Arial, Helvetica — system defaults with no character
565	- system-ui alone without a named font — signals zero design intent
566	
567	```html
568	
569	
570	
571	```
572	
573	Define as CSS variables for easy reference:
574	```css
575	:root {
576	  --font-body: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif;
577	  --font-mono: 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
578	}
579	```
580	
581	**Font pairings** (rotate — never use the same pairing twice in a row):
582	
583	| Body / Headings | Mono / Labels | Feel | Use for |
584	|---|---|---|---|
585	| DM Sans | Fira Code | Friendly, developer | Blueprint, technical docs |
586	| Instrument Serif | JetBrains Mono | Editorial, refined | Plan reviews, decision logs |
587	| IBM Plex Sans | IBM Plex Mono | Reliable, readable | Architecture diagrams |
588	| Bricolage Grotesque | Fragment Mono | Bold, characterful | Data tables, dashboards |
589	| Plus Jakarta Sans | Azeret Mono | Rounded, approachable | Status reports, audits |
590	| Outfit | Space Mono | Clean geometric, modern | Flowcharts, pipelines |
591	| Sora | IBM Plex Mono | Technical, precise | ER diagrams, schemas |
592	| Crimson Pro | Noto Sans Mono | Scholarly, serious | RFC reviews, specs |
593	| Fraunces | Source Code Pro | Warm, distinctive | Project recaps |
594	| Geist | Geist Mono | Vercel-inspired, sharp | Modern API docs |
595	| Red Hat Display | Red Hat Mono | Cohesive family | System overviews |
596	| Libre Franklin | Inconsolata | Classic, reliable | Data-dense tables |
597	| Playfair Display | Roboto Mono | Elegant contrast | Executive summaries |
598	
599	The first 5 pairings are recommended for most use cases. Vary across consecutive diagrams.
600	
601	### Typography by Content Voice
602	
603	For prose-heavy pages (documentation, articles, essays), match typography to the content's voice:
604	
605	| Voice | Fonts | Best For |
606	|-------|-------|----------|
607	| **Literary / Thoughtful** | Literata, Lora, Newsreader, Merriweather | Essays, personal posts, long-form articles |
608	| **Technical / Precise** | IBM Plex Sans + Mono, Geist + Geist Mono, Source family | Documentation, READMEs, API references |
609	| **Bold / Contemporary** | Bricolage Grotesque, Space Grotesk, DM Sans | Product pages, feature announcements |
610	| **Minimal / Focused** | Source Serif 4 + Source Sans 3, Karla + Inconsolata | Tutorials, how-tos, focused reading |
611	
612	**Literata** deserves special mention — it has optical sizing designed specifically for screen reading. Google's answer to Georgia, but modernized.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['ml_architecture']

nodes = {n['id']: n for n in data['nodes']}
edges = data['edges']

# ── Color scheme (dark theme) ──
BG = '#0d1117'
SURFACE = '#161b22'
BORDER = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'

LAYER_COLORS = {
    'data-layer': '#3b82f6',        # blue
    'compute-layer': '#22c55e',     # green
    'serving-layer': '#f59e0b',     # orange
    'observability-layer': '#ef4444', # red
}
LAYER_COLORS_DIM = {
    'data-layer': '#1e3a5f',
    'compute-layer': '#14532d',
    'serving-layer': '#451a03',
    'observability-layer': '#450a0a',
}
LAYER_COLORS_EDGE = {
    'data-layer': '#60a5fa',
    'compute-layer': '#4ade80',
    'serving-layer': '#fbbf24',
    'observability-layer': '#f87171',
}

# ── Custom node positions (x, y) for clear pipeline flow ──
positions = {
    'data_platform':       (0.0, 2.5),
    'feature_store':       (2.5, 2.5),
    'training_cluster':    (5.0, 2.5),
    'model_registry':      (7.5, 2.5),
    'inference_online':    (10.0, 3.5),
    'inference_offline':   (10.0, 1.5),
    'ab_experiment':       (12.5, 2.5),
    'monitoring':          (15.0, 2.5),
    'version_control':     (5.0, 0.0),
}

# ── Setup figure ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 10), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 17.5)
ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 5.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Draw edges ──
# Edge style mapping
EDGE_STYLES = {
    'primary': ('solid', 1.0),
    'feedback': ('dotted', 0.7),
    'lineage': ('dashed', 0.6),
}

# Throughput range for width scaling: 0.1 to 12.5
MIN_T = 0.1
MAX_T = 12.5
MIN_W = 1.0
MAX_W = 8.0

def throughput_to_width(t):
    return MIN_W + (t - MIN_T) / (MAX_T - MIN_T) * (MAX_W - MIN_W)

# Draw edges first (behind nodes)
for edge in edges:
    src = edge['source']
    tgt = edge['target']
    flow = edge['flow_type']
    tput = edge['throughput_gbps']
    label = edge['label']

    if src not in positions or tgt not in positions:
        continue

    x1, y1 = positions[src]
    x2, y2 = positions[tgt]

    style, alpha = EDGE_STYLES.get(flow, ('solid', 0.8))
    width = throughput_to_width(tput)

    # Edge color based on source node layer
    src_layer = nodes[src]['category']
    edge_color = LAYER_COLORS_EDGE.get(src_layer, '#8b949e')

    # For feedback edges use a warmer tone
    if flow == 'feedback':
        edge_color = '#fb923c'
    elif flow == 'lineage':
        edge_color = '#a78bfa'

    # Draw curved arrows for feedback and lineage
    if flow == 'feedback':
        # Curved arc back from monitoring
        rad = 0.3 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.5
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)
    elif flow == 'lineage':
        # Dashed lineage connections
        rad = 0.2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)
    else:
        # Primary edges with slight curvature when needed
        dy = y2 - y1
        dx = x2 - x1
        if dx > 3 and abs(dy) > 0.5:
             rad = 0.15 * (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
        else:
             rad = 0.0
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)

    # Edge label at midpoint
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2
    if flow == 'lineage':
        my -= 0.25
    elif flow == 'feedback':
        my += 0.4

    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=7, color=edge_color, alpha=0.8,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7))

# ── Draw nodes ──
for node_id, pos in positions.items():
    node = nodes[node_id]
    layer = node['category']
    crit = node['criticality']
    label = node['label']

    # Node size proportional to criticality (min 0.3, max 0.8 radius)
    radius = 0.3 + (crit - 1) / 9 * 0.5  # maps 1..10 to 0.3..0.8

    fill_color = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
    fill_dim = LAYER_COLORS_DIM[layer]
    edge_color = LAYER_COLORS_EDGE[layer]

    # Draw glow/shadow
    glow = plt.Circle(pos, radius + 0.08, color=edge_color, alpha=0.2, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Draw main node circle
    circle = plt.Circle(pos, radius, facecolor=fill_dim, edgecolor=edge_color,
                        linewidth=2.0, zorder=3, alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

    # Draw inner gradient effect (smaller concentric circle)
    inner = plt.Circle(pos, radius * 0.65, facecolor=fill_color, alpha=0.3, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(inner)

    # Node label
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1], label.replace('\\n', '\n'), fontsize=9,
            color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
            fontfamily='monospace', zorder=5, linespacing=1.3)

    # Criticality badge
    badge_x = pos[0] + radius * 0.7
    badge_y = pos[1] + radius * 0.7
    badge = plt.Circle((badge_x, badge_y), 0.18, facecolor=edge_color, edgecolor='none',
                       zorder=6, alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(badge)
    ax.text(badge_x, badge_y, str(crit), fontsize=7, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

# ── Sub-component labels (below each node) ──
for node_id, pos in positions.items():
    node = nodes[node_id]
    subs = node['sub_components']
    subs_text = ' · '.join(subs)
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1] - 0.55, subs_text, fontsize=6, color='#8b949e',
            ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

# ── Layer boundary shading ──
layer_zones = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -0.8, 3.3, 3.5, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 3.7, 4.3, 9.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 8.7, 5.3, 14.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['serving-layer']),
    ('OBSERVABILITY', 13.7, 3.3, 17.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['observability-layer']),
]

for label_text, x_start, y_top, x_end, height, color in layer_zones:
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x_start, y_top - height),
        x_end - x_start, height,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.1',
        facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.04, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x_start + (x_end - x_start) / 2, y_top + 0.15, label_text,
            fontsize=7, color=color, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.4,
            letter_spacing=2)

# ── Version Control zone label ──
ax.text(5.0, -0.6, 'CROSS-CUTTING · DATA LINEAGE', fontsize=7,
        color='#a78bfa', ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace',
        fontweight='bold', alpha=0.4, letter_spacing=2)

# ── Title ──
ax.text(7.5, 5.0, 'ML Infrastructure Pipeline Architecture', fontsize=20,
        color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='monospace')
ax.text(7.5, 4.55, 'End-to-End Data Flow · Model Lifecycle · Observability Feedback Loop',
        fontsize=10, color='#8b949e', ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='monospace')

# ── Legend ──
legend_y = -1.2
legend_items = []

# Edge type legend
legend_items.append((0.2, 'Edge Types'))
legend_items.append((0.2, None))  # spacer

# Primary flow
ax.plot([0.2, 1.0], [-0.9, -0.9], color='#8b949e', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(1.1, -0.9, 'Primary Data Flow', fontsize=7, color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Feedback
ax.plot([3.2, 4.0], [-0.9, -0.9], color='#fb923c', lw=2, linestyle='dotted', solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(4.1, -0.9, 'Feedback Loop', fontsize=7, color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Lineage
ax.plot([6.5, 7.3], [-0.9, -0.9], color='#a78bfa', lw=1.5, linestyle='dashed', solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(7.4, -0.9, 'Lineage / Version Control', fontsize=7, color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Layer color legend
layer_legend_y = -0.9
for i, (layer_name, color) in enumerate([
    ('Data Layer', LAYER_COLORS['data-layer']),
    ('Compute Layer', LAYER_COLORS['compute-layer']),
    ('Serving Layer', LAYER_COLORS['serving-layer']),
    ('Observability', LAYER_COLORS['observability-layer']),
]):
    x = 10.0 + i * 2.2
    circle = plt.Circle((x, layer_legend_y), 0.12, facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    ax.text(x + 0.2, layer_legend_y, layer_name, fontsize=7, color='#8b949e',
            va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Node size legend
size_legend_y = -0.5
ax.text(10.0, size_legend_y, 'Node size ∝ Criticality (1–10)', fontsize=7,
        color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)
ax.text(14.5, size_legend_y, 'Edge width ∝ Throughput (Gbps)', fontsize=7,
        color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

# ── Throughput annotation on thickest edge ──
ax.text(0.0, 3.3, '12.5 Gbps', fontsize=6, color='#60a5fa', ha='center',
        fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.7)

# ── Save ──
plt.tight_layout(pad=2)
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.5)
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['ml_architecture']

nodes = {n['id']: n for n in data['nodes']}
edges = data['edges']

# ── Color scheme (dark theme) ──
BG = '#0a0e14'
SURFACE = '#131820'

LAYER_FILL = {
    'data-layer': '#1d4ed8',
    'compute-layer': '#15803d',
    'serving-layer': '#d97706',
    'observability-layer': '#dc2626',
}
LAYER_SURFACE = {
    'data-layer': '#1e3a5f',
    'compute-layer': '#14532d',
    'serving-layer': '#78350f',
    'observability-layer': '#450a0a',
}
LAYER_GLOW = {
    'data-layer': '#3b82f6',
    'compute-layer': '#22c55e',
    'serving-layer': '#f59e0b',
    'observability-layer': '#ef4444',
}

# ── Node positions ──
pos = {
    'data_platform':       (0.0, 3.0),
    'feature_store':       (3.5, 3.0),
    'training_cluster':    (7.0, 3.0),
    'model_registry':      (10.5, 3.0),
    'inference_online':    (14.0, 4.5),
    'inference_offline':   (14.0, 1.5),
    'ab_experiment':       (17.0, 3.0),
    'monitoring':          (20.0, 3.0),
    'version_control':     (7.0, 0.0),
}

# ── Figure setup ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(28, 12), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 23.0)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 6.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Helper: throughput → linewidth ──
def tw(t):
    return 0.8 + (t - 0.1) / (12.5 - 0.1) * 7.2

# ── Draw layer zones ──
layer_bounds = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -1.5, 5.5, 5.5, LAYER_GLOW['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 5.5, 8.5, 12.5, LAYER_GLOW['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 12.5, 6.5, 18.5, LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer']),
    ('OBSERVABILITY', 18.5, 5.5, 22.0, LAYER_GLOW['observability-layer']),
]
for label, x0, y_top, x1, color in layer_bounds:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y_top - 4.5), x1 - x0, 4.5,
                          boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=color,
                          edgecolor='none', alpha=0.03, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x0 + (x1 - x0) / 2, y_top + 0.08, label, fontsize=7.5,
            color=color, ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='monospace',
            fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)
# Cross-cutting zone
ax.text(7.0, -1.3, 'CROSS-CUTTING', fontsize=7.5, color='#a78bfa',
        ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)

# ── Helper: draw curved edge ──
def draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw, style, label, rad=0.0, label_off=(0,0)):
    if style == 'dotted':
        ls = (0, (1, 3))
    elif style == 'dashed':
        ls = (0, (5, 4))
    else:
        ls = 'solid'

    if rad != 0:
        conn = f'arc3,rad={rad}'
    else:
        conn = 'arc3,rad=0'

    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color,
                                lw=lw, linestyle=ls,
                                connectionstyle=conn,
                                mutation_scale=15),
                zorder=1)

    # Edge label
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2 + label_off[0]
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2 + label_off[1]
    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=6.5, color=color,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.75,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor=BG,
                      edgecolor='none', alpha=0.75))

# ── Draw edges ──
# 1. Primary edges (solid, colored by source layer)
primary_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'primary']
for e in primary_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    color = LAYER_GLOW.get(nodes[src]['category'], '#94a3b8')
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]

    # Determine curvature for branching
    rad = 0
    lo = (0, 0)
    if src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.2
        lo = (-0.2, 0.15)
    elif src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_offline':
        rad = -0.2
        lo = (-0.2, -0.15)
    elif src == 'inference_online' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = -0.15
        lo = (0, -0.3)
    elif src == 'inference_offline' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = 0.15
        lo = (0, 0.3)
    elif src == 'feature_store' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.35
        lo = (-0.5, 0.5)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'solid', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 2. Feedback edges (dotted, orange)
feedback_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'feedback']
for e in feedback_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    rad = 0.5 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.6
    lo = (0.0, 0.6) if tgt == 'training_cluster' else (0.8, 0.5)
    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, '#fb923c', tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'dotted', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 3. Lineage edges (dashed, purple)
lineage_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'lineage']
for e in lineage_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    if src == 'version_control':
        rad = 0.3 if tgt == 'model_registry' else (0.2 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.15)
    elif src == 'data_platform':
        rad = -0.4
    else:
        rad = 0
    lo = (0, 0)
    if src == 'version_control':
        lo = (0, -0.25)
    elif src == 'data_platform':
        lo = (0, -0.4)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, '#c084fc', tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'dashed', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# ── Draw nodes ──
for nid, (x, y) in pos.items():
    node = nodes[nid]
    layer = node['category']
    crit = node['criticality']
    label_text = node['label'].replace('\\n', '\n')

    # Radius: 0.35 to 0.65 based on criticality (1-10)
    r = 0.4 + (crit - 1) / 9 * 0.35

    # Outer glow ring
    glow_r = r + 0.1
    glow = plt.Circle((x, y), glow_r, facecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer],
                      alpha=0.12, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Main circle
    circle = plt.Circle((x, y), r, facecolor=LAYER_SURFACE[layer],
                        edgecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer], linewidth=2.2,
                        zorder=3, alpha=0.95)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

    # Inner highlight
    inner = plt.Circle((x, y), r * 0.7, facecolor=LAYER_FILL[layer],
                       alpha=0.25, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(inner)

    # Label
    ax.text(x, y, label_text, fontsize=8.5, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
            fontfamily='monospace', zorder=5, linespacing=1.2)

    # Criticality badge (top-right of node)
    bx = x + r * 0.65
    by = y + r * 0.65
    badge_r = 0.16
    badge = plt.Circle((bx, by), badge_r, facecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer],
                       edgecolor='none', zorder=6)
    ax.add_patch(badge)
    ax.text(bx, by, str(crit), fontsize=7, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

    # Sub-components below
    subs = '  ·  '.join(node['sub_components'])
    ax.text(x, y - r - 0.25, subs, fontsize=6, color='#64748b',
            ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.55)

# ── Pipeline flow annotation ──
# Main pipeline arrow labels at the top
ax.annotate('', xy=(1.5, 3.95), xytext=(0.0, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(5.0, 3.95), xytext=(3.5, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(8.5, 3.95), xytext=(7.0, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(12.0, 3.95), xytext=(10.5, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)

# ── Title section ──
ax.text(8.75, 6.1, 'ML Infrastructure Pipeline Architecture', fontsize=22,
        color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='monospace')
ax.text(8.75, 5.65, 'End-to-End Data Flow  ·  Model Lifecycle  ·  Observability Feedback Loop',
        fontsize=9.5, color='#64748b', ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# ── Legend ──
legend_x = 0.0
legend_y = -1.7

# Edge type legend
ax.text(legend_x, legend_y + 0.5, 'EDGE TYPES', fontsize=7, color='#64748b',
        fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold')

# Primary
ax.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.7], [legend_y + 0.1, legend_y + 0.1],
        color='#94a3b8', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(legend_x + 0.85, legend_y + 0.1, 'Primary Data Flow', fontsize=7,
        color='#94a3b8', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Feedback
ax.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.7], [legend_y - 0.25, legend_y - 0.25],
        color='#fb923c', lw=2, linestyle=(0, (1, 3)), solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(legend_x + 0.85, legend_y - 0.25, 'Feedback Loop', fontsize=7,
        color='#94a3b8', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Lineage
ax.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.7], [legend_y - 0.6, legend_y - 0.6],
        color='#c084fc', lw=1.8, linestyle=(0, (5, 4)), solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(legend_x + 0.85, legend_y - 0.6, 'Data Lineage / VC', fontsize=7,
        color='#94a3b8', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Layer legend
lx_start = 6.0
ax.text(lx_start, legend_y + 0.5, 'NODE LAYERS', fontsize=7, color='#64748b',
        fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold')
for i, (name, color) in enumerate([
    ('Data', LAYER_GLOW['data-layer']),
    ('Compute', LAYER_GLOW['compute-layer']),
    ('Serving', LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer']),
    ('Observability', LAYER_GLOW['observability-layer']),
]):
    x = lx_start + i * 2.2
    c = plt.Circle((x, legend_y + 0.1), 0.11, facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(c)
    ax.text(x + 0.18, legend_y + 0.1, name, fontsize=7, color='#94a3b8',
            va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Size legend
ax.text(lx_start, legend_y - 0.35, 'Node radius ∝ Criticality (1–10)    Edge width ∝ Throughput (0.1–12.5 Gbps)',
        fontsize=6.5, color='#475569', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

# ── Annotation: online/offline branching ──
ax.annotate('ONLINE\n(Real-time)', xy=(13.0, 4.7), fontsize=7,
            color=LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer'], ha='center',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.6)
ax.annotate('OFFLINE\n(Batch)', xy=(13.0, 1.3), fontsize=7,
            color=LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer'], ha='center',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.6)

# ── Annotation: feedback loop ──
ax.annotate('CLOSED-LOOP\nFEEDBACK', xy=(17.5, 5.2), fontsize=7,
            color='#fb923c', ha='center', fontfamily='monospace',
            fontweight='bold', alpha=0.5,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=BG,
                      edgecolor='#fb923c', alpha=0.15))

# ── Save ──
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.6)
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['ml_architecture']

nodes = {n['id']: n for n in data['nodes']}
edges = data['edges']

# ── Color scheme (dark theme) ──
BG = '#0a0e14'
SURFACE = '#131820'

LAYER_FILL = {
    'data-layer': '#1d4ed8',
    'compute-layer': '#15803d',
    'serving-layer': '#d97706',
    'observability-layer': '#dc2626',
}
LAYER_SURFACE = {
    'data-layer': '#1e3a5f',
    'compute-layer': '#14532d',
    'serving-layer': '#78350f',
    'observability-layer': '#450a0a',
}
LAYER_GLOW = {
    'data-layer': '#3b82f6',
    'compute-layer': '#22c55e',
    'serving-layer': '#f59e0b',
    'observability-layer': '#ef4444',
}

# ── Node positions ──
pos = {
    'data_platform':       (0.0, 3.0),
    'feature_store':       (3.5, 3.0),
    'training_cluster':    (7.0, 3.0),
    'model_registry':      (10.5, 3.0),
    'inference_online':    (14.0, 4.5),
    'inference_offline':   (14.0, 1.5),
    'ab_experiment':       (17.0, 3.0),
    'monitoring':          (20.0, 3.0),
    'version_control':     (7.0, 0.0),
}

# ── Figure setup ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(28, 12), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 23.0)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 6.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Helper: throughput → linewidth ──
def tw(t):
    return 0.8 + (t - 0.1) / (12.5 - 0.1) * 7.2

# ── Draw layer zones ──
layer_bounds = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -1.5, 5.5, 5.5, LAYER_GLOW['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 5.5, 8.5, 12.5, LAYER_GLOW['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 12.5, 6.5, 18.5, LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer']),
    ('OBSERVABILITY', 18.5, 5.5, 22.0, LAYER_GLOW['observability-layer']),
]
for label, x0, y_top, x1, color in layer_bounds:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y_top - 4.5), x1 - x0, 4.5,
                          boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=color,
                          edgecolor='none', alpha=0.03, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x0 + (x1 - x0) / 2, y_top + 0.08, label, fontsize=7.5,
            color=color, ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='monospace',
            fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)
# Cross-cutting zone
ax.text(7.0, -1.3, 'CROSS-CUTTING', fontsize=7.5, color='#a78bfa',
        ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)

# ── Helper: draw curved edge ──
def draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw, style, label, rad=0.0, label_off=(0,0)):
    if style == 'dotted':
        ls = (0, (1, 3))
    elif style == 'dashed':
        ls = (0, (5, 4))
    else:
        ls = 'solid'

    if rad != 0:
        conn = f'arc3,rad={rad}'
    else:
        conn = 'arc3,rad=0'

    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color,
                                lw=lw, linestyle=ls,
                                connectionstyle=conn,
                                mutation_scale=15),
                zorder=1)

    # Edge label
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2 + label_off[0]
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2 + label_off[1]
    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=6.5, color=color,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.75,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor=BG,
                      edgecolor='none', alpha=0.75))

# ── Draw edges ──
# 1. Primary edges (solid, colored by source layer)
primary_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'primary']
for e in primary_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    color = LAYER_GLOW.get(nodes[src]['category'], '#94a3b8')
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]

    # Determine curvature for branching
    rad = 0
    lo = (0, 0)
    if src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.2
        lo = (-0.2, 0.15)
    elif src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_offline':
        rad = -0.2
        lo = (-0.2, -0.15)
    elif src == 'inference_online' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = -0.15
        lo = (0, -0.3)
    elif src == 'inference_offline' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = 0.15
        lo = (0, 0.3)
    elif src == 'feature_store' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.35
        lo = (-0.5, 0.5)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'solid', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 2. Feedback edges (dotted, orange)
feedback_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'feedback']
for e in feedback_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    rad = 0.5 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.6
    lo = (0.0, 0.6) if tgt == 'training_cluster' else (0.8, 0.5)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['ml_architecture']

nodes = {n['id']: n for n in data['nodes']}
edges = data['edges']

# ── Color scheme (dark theme) ──
BG = '#0d1117'
SURFACE = '#161b22'
BORDER = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'

LAYER_COLORS = {
    'data-layer': '#3b82f6',        # blue
    'compute-layer': '#22c55e',     # green
    'serving-layer': '#f59e0b',     # orange
    'observability-layer': '#ef4444', # red
}
LAYER_COLORS_DIM = {
    'data-layer': '#1e3a5f',
    'compute-layer': '#14532d',
    'serving-layer': '#451a03',
    'observability-layer': '#450a0a',
}
LAYER_COLORS_EDGE = {
    'data-layer': '#60a5fa',
    'compute-layer': '#4ade80',
    'serving-layer': '#fbbf24',
    'observability-layer': '#f87171',
}

# ── Custom node positions (x, y) for clear pipeline flow ──
positions = {
    'data_platform':       (0.0, 2.5),
    'feature_store':       (2.5, 2.5),
    'training_cluster':    (5.0, 2.5),
    'model_registry':      (7.5, 2.5),
    'inference_online':    (10.0, 3.5),
    'inference_offline':   (10.0, 1.5),
    'ab_experiment':       (12.5, 2.5),
    'monitoring':          (15.0, 2.5),
    'version_control':     (5.0, 0.0),
}

# ── Setup figure ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 10), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 17.5)
ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 5.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Draw edges ──
# Edge style mapping
EDGE_STYLES = {
    'primary': ('solid', 1.0),
    'feedback': ('dotted', 0.7),
    'lineage': ('dashed', 0.6),
}

# Throughput range for width scaling: 0.1 to 12.5
MIN_T = 0.1
MAX_T = 12.5
MIN_W = 1.0
MAX_W = 8.0

def throughput_to_width(t):
    return MIN_W + (t - MIN_T) / (MAX_T - MIN_T) * (MAX_W - MIN_W)

# Draw edges first (behind nodes)
for edge in edges:
    src = edge['source']
    tgt = edge['target']
    flow = edge['flow_type']
    tput = edge['throughput_gbps']
    label = edge['label']

    if src not in positions or tgt not in positions:
        continue

    x1, y1 = positions[src]
    x2, y2 = positions[tgt]

    style, alpha = EDGE_STYLES.get(flow, ('solid', 0.8))
    width = throughput_to_width(tput)

    # Edge color based on source node layer
    src_layer = nodes[src]['category']
    edge_color = LAYER_COLORS_EDGE.get(src_layer, '#8b949e')

    # For feedback edges use a warmer tone
    if flow == 'feedback':
        edge_color = '#fb923c'
    elif flow == 'lineage':
        edge_color = '#a78bfa'

    # Draw curved arrows for feedback and lineage
    if flow == 'feedback':
        # Curved arc back from monitoring
        rad = 0.3 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.5
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)
    elif flow == 'lineage':
        # Dashed lineage connections
        rad = 0.2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)
    else:
        # Primary edges with slight curvature when needed
        dy = y2 - y1
        dx = x2 - x1
        if dx > 3 and abs(dy) > 0.5:
             rad = 0.15 * (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
        else:
             rad = 0.0
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)

    # Edge label at midpoint
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2
    if flow == 'lineage':
        my -= 0.25
    elif flow == 'feedback':
        my += 0.4

    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=7, color=edge_color, alpha=0.8,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7))

# ── Draw nodes ──
for node_id, pos in positions.items():
    node = nodes[node_id]
    layer = node['category']
    crit = node['criticality']
    label = node['label']

    # Node size proportional to criticality (min 0.3, max 0.8 radius)
    radius = 0.3 + (crit - 1) / 9 * 0.5  # maps 1..10 to 0.3..0.8

    fill_color = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
    fill_dim = LAYER_COLORS_DIM[layer]
    edge_color = LAYER_COLORS_EDGE[layer]

    # Draw glow/shadow
    glow = plt.Circle(pos, radius + 0.08, color=edge_color, alpha=0.2, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Draw main node circle
    circle = plt.Circle(pos, radius, facecolor=fill_dim, edgecolor=edge_color,
                        linewidth=2.0, zorder=3, alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

    # Draw inner gradient effect (smaller concentric circle)
    inner = plt.Circle(pos, radius * 0.65, facecolor=fill_color, alpha=0.3, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(inner)

    # Node label
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1], label.replace('\\n', '\n'), fontsize=9,
            color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
            fontfamily='monospace', zorder=5, linespacing=1.3)

    # Criticality badge
    badge_x = pos[0] + radius * 0.7
    badge_y = pos[1] + radius * 0.7
    badge = plt.Circle((badge_x, badge_y), 0.18, facecolor=edge_color, edgecolor='none',
                       zorder=6, alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(badge)
    ax.text(badge_x, badge_y, str(crit), fontsize=7, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

# ── Sub-component labels (below each node) ──
for node_id, pos in positions.items():
    node = nodes[node_id]
    subs = node['sub_components']
    subs_text = ' · '.join(subs)
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1] - 0.55, subs_text, fontsize=6, color='#8b949e',
            ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

# ── Layer boundary shading ──
layer_zones = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -0.8, 3.3, 3.5, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 3.7, 4.3, 9.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 8.7, 5.3, 14.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['serving-layer']),
    ('OBSERVABILITY', 13.7, 3.3, 17.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['observability-layer']),
]

for label_text, x_start, y_top, x_end, height, color in layer_zones:
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x_start, y_top - height),
        x_end - x_start, height,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.1',
        facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.04, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x_start + (x_end - x_start) / 2, y_top + 0.15, label_text,
            fontsize=7, color=color, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.4)

# ── Version Control zone label ──
ax.text(5.0, -0.6, 'CROSS-CUTTING · DATA LINEAGE', fontsize=7,
        color='#a78bfa', ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace',
        fontweight='bold', alpha=0.4)

# ── Title ──
ax.text(7.5, 5.0, 'ML Infrastructure Pipeline Architecture', fontsize=20,
        color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='monospace')
ax.text(7.5, 4.55, 'End-to-End Data Flow · Model Lifecycle · Observability Feedback Loop',
        fontsize=10, color='#8b949e', ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='monospace')

# ── Legend ──
legend_y = -1.2
legend_items = []

# Edge type legend
legend_items.append((0.2, 'Edge Types'))
legend_items.append((0.2, None))  # spacer

# Primary flow
ax.plot([0.2, 1.0], [-0.9, -0.9], color='#8b949e', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(1.1, -0.9, 'Primary Data Flow', fontsize=7, color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Feedback
ax.plot([3.2, 4.0], [-0.9, -0.9], color='#fb923c', lw=2, linestyle='dotted', solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(4.1, -0.9, 'Feedback Loop', fontsize=7, color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Lineage
ax.plot([6.5, 7.3], [-0.9, -0.9], color='#a78bfa', lw=1.5, linestyle='dashed', solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(7.4, -0.9, 'Lineage / Version Control', fontsize=7, color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Layer color legend
layer_legend_y = -0.9
for i, (layer_name, color) in enumerate([
    ('Data Layer', LAYER_COLORS['data-layer']),
    ('Compute Layer', LAYER_COLORS['compute-layer']),
    ('Serving Layer', LAYER_COLORS['serving-layer']),
    ('Observability', LAYER_COLORS['observability-layer']),
]):
    x = 10.0 + i * 2.2
    circle = plt.Circle((x, layer_legend_y), 0.12, facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    ax.text(x + 0.2, layer_legend_y, layer_name, fontsize=7, color='#8b949e',
            va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Node size legend
size_legend_y = -0.5
ax.text(10.0, size_legend_y, 'Node size ∝ Criticality (1–10)', fontsize=7,
        color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)
ax.text(14.5, size_legend_y, 'Edge width ∝ Throughput (Gbps)', fontsize=7,
        color='#8b949e', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

}

ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 23.0)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 6.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

layer_bounds = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -1.5, 5.5, 5.5, LAYER_GLOW['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 5.5, 8.5, 12.5, LAYER_GLOW['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 12.5, 6.5, 18.5, LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer']),

]
for label, x0, y_top, x1, color in layer_bounds:

                          boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=color,
                          edgecolor='none', alpha=0.03, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x0 + (x1 - x0) / 2, y_top + 0.08, label, fontsize=7.5,
            color=color, ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='monospace',
            fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)
# Cross-cutting zone
ax.text(7.0, -1.3, 'CROSS-CUTTING', fontsize=7.5, color='#a78bfa',
        ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)

# ── Helper: draw curved edge ──
def draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw, style, label, rad=0.0, label_off=(0,0)):
    if style == 'dotted':
        ls = (0, (1, 3))
    elif style == 'dashed':
        ls = (0, (5, 4))
    else:
        ls = 'solid'

    if rad != 0:
        conn = f'arc3,rad={rad}'
    else:
        conn = 'arc3,rad=0'

    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color,
                                lw=lw, linestyle=ls,
                                connectionstyle=conn,
                                mutation_scale=15),
                zorder=1)

    # Edge label
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2 + label_off[0]
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2 + label_off[1]
    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=6.5, color=color,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.75,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor=BG,
                      edgecolor='none', alpha=0.75))

# ── Draw edges ──
# 1. Primary edges (solid, colored by source layer)
primary_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'primary']
for e in primary_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    color = LAYER_GLOW.get(nodes[src]['category'], '#94a3b8')
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]

    # Determine curvature for branching
    rad = 0
    lo = (0, 0)
    if src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.2
        lo = (-0.2, 0.15)
    elif src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_offline':
        rad = -0.2
        lo = (-0.2, -0.15)
    elif src == 'inference_online' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = -0.15
        lo = (0, -0.3)
    elif src == 'inference_offline' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = 0.15
        lo = (0, 0.3)
    elif src == 'feature_store' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.35
        lo = (-0.5, 0.5)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'solid', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 2. Feedback edges (dotted, orange)
feedback_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'feedback']
for e in feedback_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    rad = 0.5 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.6
    lo = (0.0, 0.6) if tgt == 'training_cluster' else (0.8, 0.5)
    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, '#fb923c', tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'dotted', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 3. Lineage edges (dashed, purple)
lineage_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'lineage']
for e in lineage_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    if src == 'version_control':
        rad = 0.3 if tgt == 'model_registry' else (0.2 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.15)
    elif src == 'data_platform':
        rad = -0.4
    else:
        rad = 0
    lo = (0, 0)
    if src == 'version_control':
        lo = (0, -0.25)
    elif src == 'data_platform':
        lo = (0, -0.4)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, '#c084fc', tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'dashed', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# ── Draw nodes ──
for nid, (x, y) in pos.items():
    node = nodes[nid]
    layer = node['category']
    crit = node['criticality']
    label_text = node['label'].replace('\\n', '\n')

    # Radius: 0.35 to 0.65 based on criticality (1-10)
    r = 0.4 + (crit - 1) / 9 * 0.35

    # Outer glow ring
    glow_r = r + 0.1
    glow = plt.Circle((x, y), glow_r, facecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer],
                      alpha=0.12, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Main circle
    circle = plt.Circle((x, y), r, facecolor=LAYER_SURFACE[layer],
                        edgecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer], linewidth=2.2,
                        zorder=3, alpha=0.95)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

    # Inner highlight
    inner = plt.Circle((x, y), r * 0.7, facecolor=LAYER_FILL[layer],
                       alpha=0.25, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(inner)

    # Label
    ax.text(x, y, label_text, fontsize=8.5, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
            fontfamily='monospace', zorder=5, linespacing=1.2)

    # Criticality badge (top-right of node)
    bx = x + r * 0.65
    by = y + r * 0.65
    badge_r = 0.16
    badge = plt.Circle((bx, by), badge_r, facecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer],
                       edgecolor='none', zorder=6)
    ax.add_patch(badge)
    ax.text(bx, by, str(crit), fontsize=7, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

    # Sub-components below
    subs = '  ·  '.join(node['sub_components'])
    ax.text(x, y - r - 0.25, subs, fontsize=6, color='#64748b',
            ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.55)

# ── Pipeline flow annotation ──
# Main pipeline arrow labels at the top
ax.annotate('', xy=(1.5, 3.95), xytext=(0.0, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(5.0, 3.95), xytext=(3.5, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(8.5, 3.95), xytext=(7.0, 3.95),

            zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(12.0, 3.95), xytext=(10.5, 3.95),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#475569', lw=1, alpha=0.4),
            zorder=0)

# ── Title section ──
ax.text(8.75, 6.1, 'ML Infrastructure Pipeline Architecture', fontsize=22,
        color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='monospace')
ax.text(8.75, 5.65, 'End-to-End Data Flow  ·  Model Lifecycle  ·  Observability Feedback Loop',
        fontsize=9.5, color='#64748b', ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# ── Legend ──
legend_x = 0.0
legend_y = -1.7

# Edge type legend
ax.text(legend_x, legend_y + 0.5, 'EDGE TYPES', fontsize=7, color='#64748b',
        fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold')

# Primary
ax.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.7], [legend_y + 0.1, legend_y + 0.1],
        color='#94a3b8', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(legend_x + 0.85, legend_y + 0.1, 'Primary Data Flow', fontsize=7,
        color='#94a3b8', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Feedback
ax.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.7], [legend_y - 0.25, legend_y - 0.25],
        color='#fb923c', lw=2, linestyle=(0, (1, 3)), solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(legend_x + 0.85, legend_y - 0.25, 'Feedback Loop', fontsize=7,
        color='#94a3b8', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Lineage
ax.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.7], [legend_y - 0.6, legend_y - 0.6],
        color='#c084fc', lw=1.8, linestyle=(0, (5, 4)), solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(legend_x + 0.85, legend_y - 0.6, 'Data Lineage / VC', fontsize=7,
        color='#94a3b8', va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Layer legend
lx_start = 6.0
ax.text(lx_start, legend_y + 0.5, 'NODE LAYERS', fontsize=7, color='#64748b',
        fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold')
for i, (name, color) in enumerate([
    ('Data', LAYER_GLOW['data-layer']),
    ('Compute', LAYER_GLOW['compute-layer']),
    ('Serving', LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer']),
    ('Observability', LAYER_GLOW['observability-layer']),
]):
    x = lx_start + i * 2.2
    c = plt.Circle((x, legend_y + 0.1), 0.11, facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(c)
    ax.text(x + 0.18, legend_y + 0.1, name, fontsize=7, color='#94a3b8',
            va='center', fontfamily='monospace')

# Size legend
ax.text(lx_start, legend_y - 0.35, 'Node radius ∝ Criticality (1–10)    Edge width ∝ Throughput (0.1–12.5 Gbps)',
        fontsize=6.5, color='#475569', va='center', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

# ── Annotation: online/offline branching ──
ax.annotate('ONLINE\n(Real-time)', xy=(13.0, 4.7), fontsize=7,
            color=LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer'], ha='center',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.6)
ax.annotate('OFFLINE\n(Batch)', xy=(13.0, 1.3), fontsize=7,
            color=LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer'], ha='center',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.6)

# ── Annotation: feedback loop ──
ax.annotate('CLOSED-LOOP\nFEEDBACK', xy=(17.5, 5.2), fontsize=7,
            color='#fb923c', ha='center', fontfamily='monospace',
            fontweight='bold', alpha=0.5,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=BG,
                      edgecolor='#fb923c', alpha=0.15))

# ── Save ──
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.6)
plt.close()

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['ml_architecture']

nodes = {n['id']: n for n in data['nodes']}
edges = data['edges']

# ── Color scheme (dark theme) ──
BG = '#0d1117'
SURFACE = '#161b22'
BORDER = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'

LAYER_COLORS = {
    'data-layer': '#3b82f6',        # blue
    'compute-layer': '#22c55e',     # green
    'serving-layer': '#f59e0b',     # orange
    'observability-layer': '#ef4444', # red
}
LAYER_COLORS_DIM = {
    'data-layer': '#1e3a5f',
    'compute-layer': '#14532d',
    'serving-layer': '#451a03',
    'observability-layer': '#450a0a',
}
LAYER_COLORS_EDGE = {
    'data-layer': '#60a5fa',
    'compute-layer': '#4ade80',
    'serving-layer': '#fbbf24',
    'observability-layer': '#f87171',
}

# ── Custom node positions (x, y) for clear pipeline flow ──
positions = {
    'data_platform':       (0.0, 2.5),
    'feature_store':       (2.5, 2.5),
    'training_cluster':    (5.0, 2.5),
    'model_registry':      (7.5, 2.5),
    'inference_online':    (10.0, 3.5),
    'inference_offline':   (10.0, 1.5),
    'ab_experiment':       (12.5, 2.5),
    'monitoring':          (15.0, 2.5),
    'version_control':     (5.0, 0.0),
}

# ── Setup figure ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 10), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 17.5)
ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 5.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Draw edges ──
# Edge style mapping
EDGE_STYLES = {
    'primary': ('solid', 1.0),
    'feedback': ('dotted', 0.7),
    'lineage': ('dashed', 0.6),
}

# Throughput range for width scaling: 0.1 to 12.5
MIN_T = 0.1
MAX_T = 12.5
MIN_W = 1.0
MAX_W = 8.0

def throughput_to_width(t):
    return MIN_W + (t - MIN_T) / (MAX_T - MIN_T) * (MAX_W - MIN_W)

# Draw edges first (behind nodes)
for edge in edges:
    src = edge['source']
    tgt = edge['target']
    flow = edge['flow_type']
    tput = edge['throughput_gbps']
    label = edge['label']

    if src not in positions or tgt not in positions:
        continue

    x1, y1 = positions[src]
    x2, y2 = positions[tgt]

    style, alpha = EDGE_STYLES.get(flow, ('solid', 0.8))
    width = throughput_to_width(tput)

    # Edge color based on source node layer
    src_layer = nodes[src]['category']
    edge_color = LAYER_COLORS_EDGE.get(src_layer, '#8b949e')

    # For feedback edges use a warmer tone
    if flow == 'feedback':
        edge_color = '#fb923c'
    elif flow == 'lineage':
        edge_color = '#a78bfa'

    # Draw curved arrows for feedback and lineage
    if flow == 'feedback':
        # Curved arc back from monitoring
        rad = 0.3 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.5
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)
    elif flow == 'lineage':
        # Dashed lineage connections
        rad = 0.2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)
    else:
        # Primary edges with slight curvature when needed
        dy = y2 - y1
        dx = x2 - x1
        if dx > 3 and abs(dy) > 0.5:
             rad = 0.15 * (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
        else:
             rad = 0.0
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=edge_color,
                                    lw=width, alpha=alpha,
                                    linestyle=style,
                                    connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'),
                    zorder=1)

    # Edge label at midpoint
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2
    if flow == 'lineage':
        my -= 0.25
    elif flow == 'feedback':
        my += 0.4

    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=7, color=edge_color, alpha=0.8,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='monospace',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7))

# ── Draw nodes ──
for node_id, pos in positions.items():
    node = nodes[node_id]
    layer = node['category']
    crit = node['criticality']
    label = node['label']

    # Node size proportional to criticality (min 0.3, max 0.8 radius)
    radius = 0.3 + (crit - 1) / 9 * 0.5  # maps 1..10 to 0.3..0.8

    fill_color = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
    fill_dim = LAYER_COLORS_DIM[layer]
    edge_color = LAYER_COLORS_EDGE[layer]

    # Draw glow/shadow
    glow = plt.Circle(pos, radius + 0.08, color=edge_color, alpha=0.2, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Draw main node circle
    circle = plt.Circle(pos, radius, facecolor=fill_dim, edgecolor=edge_color,
                        linewidth=2.0, zorder=3, alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

    # Draw inner gradient effect (smaller concentric circle)
    inner = plt.Circle(pos, radius * 0.65, facecolor=fill_color, alpha=0.3, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(inner)

    # Node label
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1], label.replace('\\n', '\n'), fontsize=9,
            color='white', ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold',
            fontfamily='monospace', zorder=5, linespacing=1.3)

    # Criticality badge
    badge_x = pos[0] + radius * 0.7
    badge_y = pos[1] + radius * 0.7
    badge = plt.Circle((badge_x, badge_y), 0.18, facecolor=edge_color, edgecolor='none',
                       zorder=6, alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(badge)
    ax.text(badge_x, badge_y, str(crit), fontsize=7, color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

# ── Sub-component labels (below each node) ──
for node_id, pos in positions.items():
    node = nodes[node_id]
    subs = node['sub_components']
    subs_text = ' · '.join(subs)
    ax.text(pos[0], pos[1] - 0.55, subs_text, fontsize=6, color='#8b949e',
            ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.6)

# ── Layer boundary shading ──
layer_zones = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -0.8, 3.3, 3.5, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 3.7, 4.3, 9.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 8.7, 5.3, 14.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['serving-layer']),
    ('OBSERVABILITY', 13.7, 3.3, 17.0, 2.6, LAYER_COLORS['observability-layer']),
]

for label_text, x_start, y_top, x_end, height, color in layer_zones:
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x_start, y_top - height),
        x_end - x_start, height,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.1',
        facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.04, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x_start + (x_end - x_start) / 2, y_top + 0.15, label_text,
            fontsize=7, color=color, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.4)

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['ml_architecture']

nodes = {n['id']: n for n in data['nodes']}
edges = data['edges']

# ── Color scheme (dark theme) ──
BG = '#0a0e14'
SURFACE = '#131820'

LAYER_FILL = {
    'data-layer': '#1d4ed8',
    'compute-layer': '#15803d',
    'serving-layer': '#d97706',

}
LAYER_SURFACE = {
    'data-layer': '#1e3a5f',
    'compute-layer': '#14532d',
    'serving-layer': '#78350f',
    'observability-layer': '#450a0a',
}
LAYER_GLOW = {
    'data-layer': '#3b82f6',
    'compute-layer': '#22c55e',
    'serving-layer': '#f59e0b',
    'observability-layer': '#ef4444',
}

pos = {

    'feature_store':       (3.5, 3.0),
    'training_cluster':    (7.0, 3.0),
    'model_registry':      (10.5, 3.0),
    'inference_online':    (14.0, 4.5),
    'inference_offline':   (14.0, 1.5),
    'ab_experiment':       (17.0, 3.0),
    'monitoring':          (20.0, 3.0),
    'version_control':     (7.0, 0.0),
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(28, 12), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 23.0)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 6.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Helper: throughput → linewidth ──
def tw(t):
    return 0.8 + (t - 0.1) / (12.5 - 0.1) * 7.2

# ── Draw layer zones ──
layer_bounds = [
    ('DATA LAYER', -1.5, 5.5, 5.5, LAYER_GLOW['data-layer']),
    ('COMPUTE LAYER', 5.5, 8.5, 12.5, LAYER_GLOW['compute-layer']),
    ('SERVING LAYER', 12.5, 6.5, 18.5, LAYER_GLOW['serving-layer']),
    ('OBSERVABILITY', 18.5, 5.5, 22.0, LAYER_GLOW['observability-layer']),
]
for label, x0, y_top, x1, color in layer_bounds:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y_top - 4.5), x1 - x0, 4.5,
                          boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=color,
                          edgecolor='none', alpha=0.03, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x0 + (x1 - x0) / 2, y_top + 0.08, label, fontsize=7.5,

# Cross-cutting zone

        ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35)

# ── Helper: draw curved edge ──
def draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw, style, label, rad=0.0, label_off=(0,0)):
    if style == 'dotted':
        ls = (0, (1, 3))
    elif style == 'dashed':
        ls = (0, (5, 4))
    else:
        ls = 'solid'

    if rad != 0:
        conn = f'arc3,rad={rad}'
    else:
        conn = 'arc3,rad=0'

    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color,
                                lw=lw, linestyle=ls,
                                connectionstyle=conn,
                                mutation_scale=15),
                zorder=1)

    # Edge label
    mx = (x1 + x2) / 2 + label_off[0]
    my = (y1 + y2) / 2 + label_off[1]
    ax.text(mx, my, label, fontsize=6.5, color=color,

    color = LAYER_GLOW.get(nodes[src]['category'], '#94a3b8')
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]

    # Determine curvature for branching

        lo = (-0.2, 0.15)
    elif src == 'model_registry' and tgt == 'inference_offline':
        rad = -0.2
        lo = (-0.2, -0.15)
    elif src == 'inference_online' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = -0.15
        lo = (0, -0.3)
    elif src == 'inference_offline' and tgt == 'ab_experiment':
        rad = 0.15
        lo = (0, 0.3)
    elif src == 'feature_store' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        rad = 0.35
        lo = (-0.5, 0.5)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'solid', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 2. Feedback edges (dotted, orange)
feedback_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'feedback']
for e in feedback_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    rad = 0.5 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.6
    lo = (0.0, 0.6) if tgt == 'training_cluster' else (0.8, 0.5)
    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, '#fb923c', tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'dotted', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# 3. Lineage edges (dashed, purple)
lineage_edges = [e for e in edges if e['flow_type'] == 'lineage']
for e in lineage_edges:
    src, tgt = e['source'], e['target']
    if src not in pos or tgt not in pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = pos[src]; x2, y2 = pos[tgt]
    if src == 'version_control':
        rad = 0.3 if tgt == 'model_registry' else (0.2 if tgt == 'training_cluster' else 0.15)
    elif src == 'data_platform':
        rad = -0.4
    else:
        rad = 0
    lo = (0, 0)
    if src == 'version_control':
        lo = (0, -0.25)
    elif src == 'data_platform':
        lo = (0, -0.4)

    draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, '#c084fc', tw(e['throughput_gbps']),
              'dashed', e['label'], rad=rad, label_off=lo)

# ── Draw nodes ──
for nid, (x, y) in pos.items():

                      alpha=0.12, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Main circle
    circle = plt.Circle((x, y), r, facecolor=LAYER_SURFACE[layer],
                        edgecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer], linewidth=2.2,
                        zorder=3, alpha=0.95)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

    # Inner highlight
    inner = plt.Circle((x, y), r * 0.7, facecolor=LAYER_FILL[layer],

    ax.add_patch(inner)

    # Criticality badge (top-right of node)
    bx = x + r * 0.65
    by = y + r * 0.65
    badge_r = 0.16
    badge = plt.Circle((bx, by), badge_r, facecolor=LAYER_GLOW[layer],

    ax.add_patch(badge)
    ax.text(bx, by, str(crit), fontsize=7, color='white',
